_note: How an offer's interruptionRatePerHour is estimated. AWS: the Spot Instance Advisor band (share of instances interrupted over the trailing 30 days) gives a monthly fraction f; the hourly rate is -ln(1 - f) / 720. That is blended with the Spot placement score (1 to 10) by a multiplier. Other spot capacity uses the provider default in providers.json; Vast.ai uses its host reliability2 as 1 - f. On-demand, reserved and Moonshift capacity are 0: their only interruptions are booked windows, which the optimizer schedules around exactly.
